name: Asset Shipment In Transit
query: select s.name as "Shipment:Link/Shipment:150", s.tracking_status as "Tracking Status:Data:110", am.name as "Asset Movement:Link/Asset Movement:160", a.name as "Asset:Link/Asset:150", a.asset_name as "Asset Name:Data:160", a.asset_serial_number as "Serial Number:Data:140", ami.source_location as "Source Location:Link/Location:150", ami.shipment_destination_location as "Final Target Location:Link/Location:170", a.location as "Current Location:Link/Location:150", s.pickup_date as "Pickup Date:Date:100", s.received_by as "Received By:Data:140", s.received_on as "Received On:Datetime:150" from `tabShipment` s join `tabShipment Document` sd on sd.parent=s.name and sd.parenttype='Shipment' join `tabAsset Movement` am on am.name=sd.reference_name and sd.reference_doctype='Asset Movement' join `tabAsset Movement Item` ami on ami.parent=am.name join `tabAsset` a on a.name=ami.asset where s.docstatus=1 and ifnull(s.tracking_status, '') != 'Delivered' and am.requires_shipment=1 and am.docstatus=1 and am.company=%(company)s and (ifnull(%(shipment)s, '')='' or s.name=%(shipment)s) and a.location=ami.target_location order by s.pickup_date, s.name, a.name
